tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Repair work on the road bridge across the stream near the house of C.S. Kirasur, located in Ward No. 18 within the jurisdiction of the Hunagunda Municipality.

itemList.description: Dismantling of existing structures like culverts, bridges, retaining walls and other structure comprising of masonry, cement concrete, wood work, steel work, including T&P and scaffolding wherever necessary, sorting the dismantled material, disposal of unserviceable material and stacking the serviceable material with all lifts and lead Mechanical Means Prestressed / RCC grade M-20 & above

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates(PWD DSR 2023-24 Vol 1 P. No.16 It No. 2.4.2)
Form Work As per recommendations of Technical working group, rates for formwork shall be added on percentage basis tothe finished concrete item rate. For drain form works consider 35%

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other type of structures (PWD Vol-1 SR 2023-24, Item No. 2.11h, Page No. 18)

KSRRB M 300-53 Construction of embackment with approved material gravel/ morrum with all lifts and leads transporting ti site spreading, grading, to required slope and compacted to meat requirement of table No 300-2 Complete as per specifications,(PWD DSR 2023-24 Vol 2 P. No.7 It No. 1.80)

Providing and constructing 300 mm thick rubble stone pitching set in CM 1: 5 proportion by volume with pin headers at 2 per m2 including cost of all materials from approved source, labour, packing stone chips and mortar into joints, finishing, curing and all other ancillary operations complete. Note: If 150 mm thick murum bed is to be provided below pitching, add 93.00 / m2 (PWD SR VOL 4 P NO 54 ITM NO WRD: 3.43)
